title: Repeated indices in a scatter
summary: What out[idx] += 1 does when idx repeats.

choices.text: `[0, 3, 0, 1]`, since each occurrence of an index adds 1.
`[0, 1, 0, 1]`, since the repeated index is written, not accumulated.
An error, because NumPy does not allow repeated indices in an assignment.
`[1, 1, 1, 1]`, because the right-hand side broadcasts over the whole array.
